source.label: Noble 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Services Agreement In February 2016, Diamond entered into a ten-year agreement with a subsidiary of Baker Hughes Company (formerly named Baker Hughes, a GE company) to provide services with respect to certain blowout preventer and related well control equipment on our drillships.

relations.text_en: Renewed a five-year framework agreement for harsh-environment jackups offshore Norway (2022)

source.label: Noble 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In 2022, Noble renewed its five-year Framework Agreement with Aker BP for the provision of ultra-harsh environment jackup rigs, the Noble Integrator and Noble Invincible , for activities in offshore Norway.

relations.text: ジャッキアップ・リグ5基を売却する契約(2025年12月発表)
relations.text_en: Agreed to sell five jackup rigs to Borr (announced December 2025)

source.label: Noble 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In December 2025, we announced that the Company signed definitive agreements to sell six jackup rigs, which includes the sale of five rigs to Borr Drilling Limited
